mcqs.question: India recorded a record solar capacity addition of how much in FY 2025–26?
mcqs.explanation: India added a record 44.61 GW of solar capacity in FY 2025–26, more than double the previous year’s addition. The tempting option of 44.61 million tonnes uses the wrong unit; the reported measure was in GW.

mcqs.question: Under the operational guidelines for the Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana (BHAVYA), which combination correctly states the implementation period and outlay?
mcqs.explanation: BHAVYA covers the period from 2026–27 to 2031–32 and has an outlay of ₹33,660 crore. The other options retain the figure but change the stated unit or omit the crore denomination.
